tests.justification: This test directly validates the requirement that '10 - 3 - 2' evaluates to '5'. It exercises the left-to-right evaluation of operators of equal precedence (subtraction) as per standard arithmetic rules. The input is simple and unambiguous, ensuring the core behavior of sequential subtraction is tested.

This test extends the requirement by adding a fourth subtraction to verify consistent left-to-right evaluation. It confirms that the calculator correctly applies the rule of left-to-right evaluation for operators of equal precedence, even with a longer sequence. This ensures robustness beyond the minimal example.

rationale: The requirement explicitly states that '10 - 3 - 2' produces '5'. This is a foundational case for testing left-to-right evaluation of subtraction. A second test with an extended sequence ('10 - 3 - 2 - 1') is added to verify the consistent application of the rule across multiple subtractions, ensuring the implementation correctly handles chains of equal-precedence operations without introducing errors or misinterpretations.
